summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated ~700KB payload
details: Package advertises itself as a React navigation component library but its package.json preinstall runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory and then execFileSync's it against a sibling file math_init.js — a ~727KB heavily obfuscated '// @bun @bun-cjs' bundle shipped inside the tarball. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, inline string-lookup objects wrapping constants like 'ldd', '/etc/os-release', 'Alpine', 'bun', platform keys). math_init.js uses a string-array rotator (WV8StW) and a large mixed number/string dictionary with _0xNNNN variable names, making the code that actually executes on the installer's machine at npm install time opaque to review. There is no legitimate reason for a UI component library to fetch an alternate language runtime at install time and use it to run an obfuscated bundle; the pattern deliberately routes execution around Node-based scanners and hides the payload from static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
